name: Chat Lift
description: Keeps Steam's on-screen keyboard out of the way. On a Steam Deck it raises the chat box and history while typing. Elsewhere, with a Steam controller under Steam, it raises chat the same way for Steam's keyboard (Steam + X), lets that keyboard type, and keeps Controlify's own keyboard for other controllers. Settings in config/chatlift.properties.
authors: Made for a Steam Deck setup
